claims_boundary: Forecasts how many tickets share a prize tier given the drawn numbers. It does not forecast the draw, and no entrant changes any ticket's probability of winning.
data_caveats: Non-contiguous sample of draws; forward-only evaluation still trains on earlier dates only.
Winner counts were transcribed from public result pages by an automated reader and have not been cell-checked against the operator.
Prize-fund money per line (1.10 EUR) is an assumption; absolute ROI depends on it.
The calibrated agent selects the lowest estimated popularity, which biases its modeled edge upward.

calibrated_escape.claims_boundary: Modeled expected return under a crowd model and stated prize-fund economics. Not realised profit; every ticket keeps the same probability of winning each tier.
